label: preparing
what: A civic presentation of thanks/appreciation for the mayor's public service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall, with bread and physical setup/materials. Mayor was initially not told until the innkeeper's request was presented; later it was disclosed and approved. Evidence supports baker and builder knowingly coordinating bread/materials, and freight and neighbour appear among reported bakery gathering participants, but their knowing contribution to the presentation is less directly established. Innkeeper is organizer; no clear record establishes every helper's exact role.
